9M26 rev QAR 19.0bn (+4.3% YoY), EBITDA QAR 8.5bn (+6.3%, 44.7% margin), FCF QAR 5.7bn (+11.2% YoY), NPAT QAR 2.9bn; completed first closing of Zain regional tower JV.
Long-term master lease agreements (10-15 year tenors) with Tier-1 telecom operators featuring contractual annual inflation escalators and power cost pass-through.
Expanding tenancy ratio (1.6x - 2.1x) yields substantial operating leverage, driving rapid organic deleveraging with minimal incremental capex.
Contracted multi-year revenue backlog exceeding 6-8x annual revenues guarantees high earnings visibility and predictable debt service capacity.

verdict.stance: Overweight / Fortress 0.4x Net Leverage Qatari Telecom (A2 / A)
verdict.summary: Ooredoo generated QAR 5.71bn FCF (+11.2% YoY) in 9M26 on QAR 18.96bn revenue (+4.3% YoY) and 44.7% EBITDA margin (QAR 8.48bn), building on FY25's 0.4x net leverage (QAR 4.11bn net debt). Sovereign linkage and disciplined capex underpin A2/A/A ratings.

positives: Strong 9M 2026 FCF inflection (+11.2% YoY to QAR 5.7bn) and EBITDA margin expansion (+90bp to 44.7%).
First closing completed on Zain regional tower JV (unlocking asset-light capital across Qatar/Kuwait).
Majority Qatari state ownership (QIA / government entities) underpins A2 / A- investment-grade ratings and low ~1.1x leverage.
negatives: FX and macro volatility in non-GCC emerging operations (Iraq, Algeria, Tunisia, Myanmar exit legacy).
Rising capex intensity into regional data centers / AI compute infrastructure.
Tight spreads (~95bp) leave limited price upside vs sovereign curve.

background.business_overview: Qatar-headquartered international telecom group operating across Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq (Asiacell), Algeria, Tunisia, and Maldives.
background.asset_perimeter: Mobile/fixed networks, regional tower JV with Zain, and expanding data-center/AI compute arm (Meeza/Syntys).
background.ownership_governance: Majority owned by Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) and Qatari state entities; listed on QSE.

Q3 2026: Completed first closing of regional tower JV combining portfolios with Zain.
